literal: Not-seeing he-of-anger, excessive great he-of-desire; enmity to-desire will-be.
translation: The enmity of a man with blind anger and excessive desire is something to be eagerly sought.
modern: எதையும் சீர்தூக்கிப் பார்க்காத கோபமும், அளவுகடந்த ஆசையும் உடையவனின் பகையை நாம் விரும்பி ஏற்கலாம்.
explanation: This couplet identifies the type of enemy whose opposition is actually advantageous. A person blinded by anger cannot think rationally or strategize well. Furthermore, someone consumed by excessive desire is easily manipulated and prone to ruinous mistakes. Because these deep character flaws will naturally lead to their own downfall, one should gladly welcome the enmity of such a person.
